paragraphs: Amazon kicked off its biggest holiday shopping event of the year earlier this week, with new deals dropping every day through November 30. For a limited time, Amazon is offering up to 35% off its latest devices, including the new Alexa Photo Frame, the Android-powered Amazon Alexa Tablet 8, 11, and 12 Pro, the new Echo Show 16 smart display, and the Echo Time bedside clock.

As usual, many devices from Apple, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, and other companies are on sale this week. Apple is offering a nice $250 discount on its 13” M6 MacBook Pro, as well as a $300 discount on its latest MacBook Pro with 16.3-inch PROLED XDR display. You’ll also find deals on the Google Pixel 11 series, the Samsung Galaxy S26 series, and the latest Microsoft Surface devices powered by Qualcomm and Nvidia chips.
I’ll be updating this long list of deals if I find new ones before the holiday sale ends on Monday, so stay tuned!
